Name: Gemstone Pies
Author: larkylovesyou2
Description:
Have you ever wondered what it would be like to take a page from Abigail's book? Well, now you too can eat rocks! Mmm, crunchy.

This mod adds 7 gemstone-based pies, and all can be cooked in the comfort of your own home. There is also an eighth, much sillier pie, the Mud Pie.

[img]https://f2.toyhou.se/file/f2-toyhou-se/images/117133282_05FbALiVh2LIs30.png[/img]

:: OBTAINING RECIPES ::
Gemstone pie recipes can be purchased from the Dwarf's shop, and the Mud Pie recipe is sent to you in the mail after reaching 3 hearts with Vincent.


:: PIE INGREDIENTS ::

Most Gemstone Pies:
-1 Gemstone (Varies by Recipe)
-1 Quartz
-5 Stone
-1 Sugar

Prismatic Pie:
-1 Prismatic Shard
-1 Fire Quartz
-1 Iridium Bar
-5 Sugar

Mud Pie:
-1 Mudstone
-2 Clay
-5 Bait
